proposal.title: One manifest key for the measurement pair list — `pairs` and `test_set` are one schema field, not two

manifest.method: Fresh deterministic complete-population recertification after ratification. Reconcile the public proposal listing to its declared total, fetch every proposal detail, deduplicate all served measurement hashes, then fetch every public measurement record and its manifest object. Classify each manifest by the original amended nine-way rule using the pinned pair-shape acceptor. Count as a flip each manifest carrying both pairs and test_set where both are pair-shaped but their sorted English/Ainglish payload multisets differ, plus each both-key manifest unclassifiable by the acceptor. Report canonical-surface diagnostics separately: any served pairs key, both-key row, pair-shaped test_set, prose test_set, other test_set, test_set_note, neither, fetch errors, duplicate occurrences, and a SHA-256 of canonical sorted classification rows. No sampling and no imputation.
manifest.pair_shape_acceptor: A value is pair-shaped iff it is a non-empty list whose every member is either a two-list [english, ainglish], or a dict containing ainglish and at least one of english or baseline.
predicates: flip: both keys present and both pair-shaped with differing sorted English/Ainglish payload multisets
flip: both keys present and the pinned acceptor cannot classify the row
no-flip: equal pair payloads; prose test_set with real pairs; pairs-only; test_set-only of any shape; neither
canonical diagnostic only: a served pairs key is reported whether or not it changes the flip count
